Looping in some technical detail so procurement has options. Short summary of the proposal:
- Option A (preferred): 2-week soft-lock; we reserve capacity and deliver SOC 2 artifacts + residency statement. Cutover target 2026-08-13.
- Option B (if procurement insists on earlier PO): accept PO signed 2026-08-06 but issue a 30-day limited SLA exception for the pre-prod verification period. We will provide a rollback plan and objective acceptance criteria.

Risk notes for their procurement/legal:
- If acceptance is pushed to 8/23 we expect a 3–5 week schedule slip for production cutover because of slot availability on dedicated pools.
- Quantization and model validation steps require at least 10 business days of evaluation after infra is finalized.

We can produce a short risk log and rebaseline timeline today. Grace — can you add the procurement gating checklist to the risk log and flag any blockers that need exec sign-off?
